query: SELECT c.relname AS table_name, t.tgname AS trigger_name, p.proname AS function_name FROM pg_trigger t JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid = t.tgrelid JOIN pg_proc p ON p.oid = t.tgfoid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname = 'public' AND NOT t.tgisinternal AND p.proname = 'schoolci_publish_notification' ORDER BY c.relname LIMIT 50; SELECT table_name FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name IN ('school_years','edutech_school_years') ORDER BY table_name LIMIT 10; SELECT target_type, target_level, target_series, COUNT(*) AS notification_count FROM public.edutech_notifications GROUP BY target_type, target_level, target_series ORDER BY notification_count DESC LIMIT 20; SELECT notification_id, user_id, COUNT(*) AS duplicate_count FROM public.edutech_notification_reads GROUP BY notification_id, user_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY duplicate_count DESC LIMIT 20;
